subject: Draft Mutual Action Plan & signature timeline for Novus Health (next steps)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP and suggested timeline — Novus Health

Hi Ruchi —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking us through the clinical workflow and the procurement milestones. Per our call, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a SOW draft to help align milestones, owners, and the target signature date you mentioned.

Quick recap from the discovery:
- Primary use-case: real-time summarization for provider notes (ED use case).
- Success criteria: 95% uptime during pilot, latency <= 400ms p50 on typical 512-token requests.
- Security requirements: SOC2 evidence plus data retention controls and isolated customer key management.

Attached items:
- Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft with milestones & owners)
- SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf (scope and pricing draft)

Proposed high-level milestones (draft):
1) Technical deep-dive + validator checklist (owner: Rohan / Redwood) — target: 2026-04-02
2) Security evidence & data flow doc (owner: Vanessa / Redwood) — target: 2026-04-09
3) Pilot (30-day) kickoff (owner: Novus) — target: 2026-04-20
4) Legal & procurement review window (owner: Novus) — target: complete by 2026-05-04
5) Contract signature / go-live commitment — target: 2026-05-14

Action items for you: can you confirm whether the 2026-05-14 signature target looks feasible given Novus procurement and legal timelines? If that date doesn't work, please propose the latest date we should aim for so we can shift the pilot accordingly.

I'll follow up with an updated MAP that includes named owners and dependencies.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa — good summary and appreciate the MAP. A few notes from procurement/legal:
- Our procurement team has an internal review window that typically concludes by the end of the month following receipt of the final SOW. For our June budget cycle we need the contract signed before 2026-05-20. Realistically, Legal will need at least two weeks after they receive the final SOW to complete redlines, so working backwards I'd like to aim for a signature no later than 2026-05-14 if possible.
- Also, we have a dependency: our IT security team needs the data flow diagram and an SSO test plan before they complete their sign-off (owner: Amit). Can Redwood provide those artifacts by 2026-04-12?

If we can get the MAP and updated SOW with those attachments and clearly assigned responsibilities this week, I can start the internal track and lock the 05/14 signature date.

On the MAP: please add an explicit legal review milestone and indicate who will own the DocuSign flow.

- Ruchi
Chief Innovation Officer
Novus Health
